correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=1 the full node-update model reduces to the displayed CTMC on center spin and number of positive ordinary leaves. Hub-fixed first updates independently give the exact finite CDF, mean, and Gumbel limit. Under a pinned leaf, a uniform e^-2 chance of ending any hub spell bounds excursion duration by e^2 H_n; the degree-weighted magnetization has generator drift (1-h)/(2(n+1)), so (2n+1)q_n=n+1+E B_n and q_n approaches 1/2. Regeneration gives an exact exponential total idle-time component and negligible O(log n) excursions; the Exp(1/2) time limit and 2n+O(log n) mean follow. Rational independently constructed full and reduced generators agree for n=1..5; finite verification is not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The center and leaves are the canonical two vertex orbits of a star; their placement is a natural controlled experiment for the power of a stubborn individual. The rigorous Gumbel versus exponential limit, logarithmic versus linear time scale, and exact leading constant 2 provide a substantive location-sensitivity benchmark for voter fixation. Not merely a familiar mean identity, arbitrary special case, or finite numerical census.
